function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Check the caller's date of birth against the account found by lookup_customer. Call only after lookup_customer's sentence asked for the date of birth. Its result is a sentence that has already been spoken to the caller.

dob_month.description: Month of birth as a number from 1 to 12, as the caller said it.

dob_day.description: Day of the month of birth, from 1 to 31, as the caller said it.

dob_year.description: Year of birth as four digits, as the caller said it.

messages.content: Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
I'm having trouble checking that right now. I can have a representative call you back, or we can try again. Which would you prefer?
